senses.gloss:
शोचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sorrowing, sorrowful.
 n. (-नं) Sorrow, grief, grie-
ving.
 E. शुच् to grieve, aff. युच् or ल्युट् ।

शोचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be grieved or lamented.
 E. शुच् to be sad, अनीयर् aff.

शोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sorrowful, afflicted.
 E. शुचि to grieve, causal v.,
क्त aff.

शोचितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be grieved for, lamentable.
 E. शुच् to grieve, तव्य aff.

शोचित्वा Ind. Grieving or having grieved for.
 E. शुचि to lament, क्त्वा aff.

शोचिष्केश m. (-शः) Fire or its deity.
 E. शोचिस् light, and केश hair,
having locks of flame.

शोचिस् n. (-चिः) Light, lustre, radiance, flame.
 E. शुच् to be or make pure, Unādi aff. इसि ।

शोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
 1. To be lamented or bewailed.
 2. To be clean-
sed or purified.
 3. Low, vile.
 E. शुच् to grieve, ण्यत् aff.

शोच्यक m. (-कः) A low man.
 E. शोच्य to be purified, (from,) कन् aff.
